title: CWP/4207/2025 of GURSEWAK SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ORS
text:
108 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision : 15.02.2025 GURSEWAK SINGH(MINOR) THR. HIS GRANDMOTHER AND GUARDIAN ee Petitioner VERSUS STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS —_E__..... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP TIWARI Present: Mr. Jashandeep Singh Bains, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Pardeep Bajaj, DAG, Punjab. KULDEEP TIWARI, J.(Oral)

1. The grievance which encapsulated in the instant petition filed under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India, is that the representation dated 03.12.2024 (Annexure P-4), made to the competent authority amongst the respondents, i.e. Deputy Commissioner, District Gurdaspur, for grant of compensation to present petitioner (minor through his grandmother), on account of injuries sustained due to stray dog bite attack incident, has not been decided.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that at this stage, the petitioner would be satisfied, in case a mandamus is passed upon respondent no.2-Deputy Commissioner, Gurdarspur, to take a final decision on the representation (supra), in view of the judgment rendered I by this Court in “Rajwinder Kaur and another vs. State of Punjab and others” (CWP-22904-2016 and other connected petitions).

3. Considering the aforesaid prayer, as made by learned counsel for the petitioner, being innocuous and bona fide, this Court, without observing anything on the merits of the instant case, directs respondent no.2-Deputy Commissioner, Gurdarspur, to take a final decision on the representation (supra), by passing a speaking order, within a period of one month from today.

4. Disposed of accordingly. (KULDEEP TIWARI) February 15, 2025 JUDGE dharamvir DHARAM VIR
